question: Estimate annual ride bookings on Ola + Uber + Rapido in Delhi NCR.
idealClarificationQuestions: All ride formats: cab + auto + bike taxi? Yes, combined across platforms.
Geography: Delhi NCR (Delhi + Gurgaon + Noida + Ghaziabad + Faridabad)? Yes — ~32M people.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: user base × ride frequency. Segment by office-goer vs occasional vs auto/bike-taxi short-trip user.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Ride-hailing app users (any platform, any month): ~40% of smartphone adults = ~7.2M.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Ride-hailing app users (any platform, any month)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: Daily commuters (office, school) ~10% = 720K @ ~40 rides/month (round trips); Frequent (3-4x/week) ~25% = 1.8M @ ~15/month; Occasional (1-3x/week) ~40% = 2.9M @ ~6/month; Rare (1-2x/month) ~25% = 1.8M @ 1.5.

calculationFlow: Ride-hailing app users (any platform, any month): ~40% of smartphone adults = ~7.2M.

Segment: Daily commuters (office, school) ~10% = 720K @ ~40 rides/month (round trips); Frequent (3-4x/week) ~25% = 1.8M @ ~15/month; Occasional (1-3x/week) ~40% = 2.9M @ ~6/month; Rare (1-2x/month) ~25% = 1.8M @ 1.5.
